recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of three men in 1970s formal attire standing before a red velvet theater curtain, framed by an ornate golden proscenium arch, featuring stylized script typography at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Three subjects centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds
Ornate golden arch framing the top and sides of the composition
Typography integrated into a circular graphic element at the top center
High contrast between the dark suits and the bright red background
coreInvariants: 1970s fashion: wide lapels, pointed collars, and feathered hair
Soft, warm lighting with a slight vintage grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three male figures positioned waist-up, occupying the central foreground at approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white suit acts as the primary anchor, flanked by figures in dark and light blue.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central typography, move down to the faces of the trio, and then follow the golden arch back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by the arch and curtain, providing space for the logo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red (curtains) and gold (arch) provide the primary atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light blue suits provide high-value contrast against the dark red.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow/Gold for the typography and architectural details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and golds; high value contrast between the suits and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded strokes with uniform weight
Curvilinear flourishes on ascenders and descenders
Tight letter spacing with overlapping elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature large, circular loops
Terminal swashes underline the entire word group

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in front of the arch

treatment.outline: Dark brown or black thin stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script paired with geometric circular graphic devices.
graphicDevices: Concentric white circles behind the text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative feel and thick strokes
Matches the rounded, tubular, and interlocking nature of the lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of three men in 1970s leisure suits (one white, one dark navy, one light blue) standing in front of a red velvet theater curtain. The scene is framed by a golden, ornate proscenium arch. Soft focus, warm lighting, film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom script logo in the top center. The lettering should be bold, rounded, yellow-gold with a thin dark outline, featuring long horizontal swashes that underline the text. Place three thin concentric white circles behind the text.

verificationChecks: Is the typography interlocking and swashed?
Are the suits period-accurate for the mid-1970s?
Is the red curtain texture visible?
Does the golden arch frame the top third of the image?

adjustableVariables: Number of concentric circles in the logo
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact brand logos or specific names
Unique architectural carvings on the arch

mustAchieve: Cohesive color palette of red, gold, and blue

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lighting creates a soft glow on the subjects' hair.
Check that the typography does not obscure the faces.
Verify the golden arch has a metallic, reflective quality.
Confirm the suits have wide, period-appropriate lapels.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Portrait + Theater Stage + Red Velvet + Golden Arch + Swash Script Typography
